title: About & Help
subtitle: Your modern personal media center to organize, enrich, and play your local library.

notices.privacy_intro: SWAYA is built with privacy in mind:

points.local_only: Local-First Architecture: All database records, metadata caches, user settings, and library structures are stored strictly on your local machine.
points.api_keys: Secured Local Credentials: Third-party API keys and access tokens (TMDb, OMDb, StashDB, etc.) are saved locally within your app configuration and are never transmitted to any third-party intermediate servers.
points.network: Direct Network Connections: Outbound network connections are strictly limited to fetching metadata directly from the official API endpoints of the active providers you configure.
points.logs: Offline Local Logging: System logs, scan histories, and error reports are kept strictly offline on your disk for troubleshooting purposes, with zero automated cloud reporting.
points.no_telemetry: Zero Telemetry & Tracking: The application contains absolutely no analytics, user tracking, usage reporting, or background telemetry. Your interactions with the application are entirely private.
points.no_sharing: No Cloud Matching: Your media library directories, filenames, and internal catalog metadata are kept strictly local. SWAYA never uploads, indexes, or shares your media collection with any cloud server or database.

license_body.p1: SWAYA is distributed under a proprietary Closed-Source License. The source code is private, proprietary, and confidential. You are not granted any rights to access, inspect, download, modify, compile, or redistribute the source code.
license_body.p2: You may only download, install, and run the official pre-compiled binary versions of the Software provided by the developer.
license_body.p3: Official installers, automatic updates, and premium services are provided exclusively by the developer and require an active subscription or a lifetime purchase.
license_body.p4: Any unauthorized copying, modification, redistribution, reverse engineering, commercial exploitation, or bypassing of the licensing system is strictly prohibited and constitutes copyright infringement.

notices.third_party_intro: SWAYA is built with gratitude using open-source libraries and APIs:

third_party_points.ui: UI Components & States: Electron, React, Vite, Zustand, React Router DOM, TanStack React Query, Lucide React, and other open-source NPM packages.
third_party_points.backend: Backend Framework: FastAPI, Uvicorn, Python, SQLite, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Pydantic, and GuessIt.
third_party_points.media: Media & OS Integration: MPV player integration, Pillow (image processing), Watchdog (file system monitoring), PyWin32, and icoextract.
third_party_points.metadata: Metadata Scrapers: TMDb, FansDB, ThePornDB, StashDB, and others.

tmdb.title: TMDb API Integration
tmdb.desc: TMDb (The Movie Database) is a free movie and TV show database. By entering your API credentials, SWAYA automatically fetches high-resolution posters, backdrops, synopses, and cast details.
tmdb.step_signup_desc: Create a free account on themoviedb.org with a unique username, password, and valid email address.
tmdb.step_email_desc: TMDb will send an activation email to your registered address. Check your inbox and click the activation link.
tmdb.step_activate_desc: Open the verification email and click 'Activate My Account' to complete your profile verification.
tmdb.step_login_desc: Once verified, log in with your credentials to access account settings and generate your API key.
tmdb.step_api_desc: Navigate to the API settings page and select the 'Developer' option to request a personal API key.
tmdb.step_terms_desc: Accept the API terms of use for developer and personal applications.
tmdb.step_details_desc: Fill in the required application details form, then click 'Submit' at the bottom of the page.
tmdb.step_access_desc: On the confirmation page, click 'Access your API key details here' to view your API Key and Read Access Token.
tmdb.step_save_desc: Copy both your API Read Access Token (v4) and API Key (v3), paste them into the fields below, and click Save.

omdb.title: OMDb API Integration
omdb.desc: OMDb API allows SWAYA to enrich titles with IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic ratings.
omdb.step_req_desc: Visit the OMDb key request page. Select the FREE tier (1,000 requests/day), enter your email address, fill in your name, and submit the request.
omdb.step_req_btn: Open OMDb API Key Request Page
omdb.step_email_desc: Check your email inbox for the automated message from OMDb API.
omdb.step_save_desc: Click the verification link inside the email to activate your key. Once activated, copy your key, paste it below, and click Save.

stashdb.step_intro_desc: StashDB is a community metadata database for adult media. Integrating it with SWAYA enables automatic fetching of performers, studios, physical attributes, tags, and scene descriptions.
stashdb.step_register_desc: Register an account at stashdb.org using an active invite key.
stashdb.step_activate_desc: Click the verification link sent to your email to choose your username and password.
stashdb.step_save_desc: Log into StashDB.org, click on your username in the top-right corner to open your profile, copy your API Key, and paste it here.

fansdb.step_intro_desc: FansDB is a crowdsourced metadata database focusing on independent adult creators and online productions.
fansdb.step_apply_desc: Submit a request to join FansDB via their application form.
fansdb.step_register_desc: Once you receive your invite code, navigate to the registration page, fill in your details, and register.
fansdb.step_save_desc: Log into FansDB, click your username in the top menu to view your profile, copy your API Key, and paste it here.

theporndb.step_intro_desc: ThePornDB provides scene metadata, high-resolution covers, and performer profiles.
theporndb.step_register_desc: Create a free account on theporndb.net with your username and email.
theporndb.step_token_desc: Log in and navigate to the API Tokens page under your profile. Give your token a name and click Create.
theporndb.step_save_desc: Copy the generated API token, paste it below, and click Save.

offline.step_single_desc:
SWAYA works fully offline without any external API keys!

• Video Snapshotting: Automatically extracts video technical details and generates snapshot thumbnails from video frames.
• Safe Organization: Physical files remain safe. You can organize files in-place or into clean target directories without requiring online lookups.
• Category Grouping: The organizer categorizes files into Movies, TV Shows, and Extras based on filename patterns.
• Full Media Management: Rate titles, write notes, track watch history, create custom lists, and organize your media collection entirely offline.
